name: context-diet
description: Cuts repeated hook boilerplate: the caveman per-prompt reminder goes out on every 10th prompt, and the caveman, ponytail and superpowers texts re-injected after a compaction shrink to a line or two each, and subagent workers get a two-line caveman text instead of the full ruleset.

reminderEvery.title: Caveman reminder interval
reminderEvery.description: The caveman per-prompt reminder is kept on the first prompt, after each compaction and on every this-many prompts. 1 keeps it on every prompt.

shortenAfterCompact.title: Shorten post-compaction texts
shortenAfterCompact.description: Replace the caveman, ponytail and superpowers SessionStart texts re-injected after a compaction with a line or two each.

shortenWorkers.title: Shorten worker caveman text
shortenWorkers.description: Replace the full caveman ruleset handed to each subagent worker at start with two lines.
